headline: Contested Sectors See Renewed Strategic Movement
war_summary: Since the last edition, Lykos Isle has become the liveliest changing front, rising to 18 strategic-base events in 24 hours, with nine in the latest six-hour watch and three bases exchanges in the latest two hours; its ledger remains six Colonial, one Warden. Fisherman’s Row still leads the field with 34 daily events and 12 in six hours, though none were logged in the latest two-hour window; ownership stands at eight Warden bases to one Colonial. Stlican Shelf records eight events, including three recently, and remains divided seven Warden to two Colonial. Oarbreaker has emerged as a fresh watch point, with two events in the latest two hours and four across the day, holding six Colonial bases against three Warden. Tempest Island likewise shows three recent events and nine daily, with eight Colonial bases, one neutral, and none Warden. Weathered Expanse remains a heavily contested nine-base sector, split five Warden to four Colonial, with five daily events. Deadlands and Farranac Coast retain divided ledgers and recent movement, while most other regions report no strategic-base events in the latest day.
